$purpose: Transmissions — FRQNCY's long-form video bed. Four kinds of content under one roof: movie (full-length film), episode (one chapter of a series), presentation (one speaker, conference- or lecture-style), panel (multi-speaker discussion). Distinct from the short-form watch library (videos.json) and the creator-tied media bed (media.json).
$schema_notes: Each entry: id (tx-<slug>), title, kind ('movie' | 'episode' | 'presentation' | 'panel'), series (only when kind=episode), episode_number, year, host_or_speakers (array), source ('youtube' | 'vimeo' | 'own' | 'external'), youtube_id (when source=youtube), url (canonical link), duration (e.g. '90 min'), desc (FRQNCY-voice editorial), appears_in (topic ids), picked_in (topics that flag it as a pick), frqncy_pick (bool).

$kinds.movie: Standalone film. Documentary, feature, dramatised. One title, one screen-able unit.
$kinds.episode: One chapter of a multi-part series. Has series + episode_number.
$kinds.presentation: One speaker addressing an audience. Lecture, conference talk, keynote, TED-style.
$kinds.panel: Multiple speakers in conversation. Roundtable, interview, podcast video, fireside chat.

transmissions.title: Source: The Frequency Movie
transmissions.desc: Dr Joe Dispenza's feature documentary on coherence, healing, and the measurable physiological changes participants undergo during his progressive workshops. Built from years of biometric data collected at his events — HRV, EEG, blood markers — paired with the personal stories of participants whose conditions resolved. The film FRQNCY would have made if FRQNCY made films.

transmissions.title: Hidden Secrets of Money — Episode 1: Currency vs Money
transmissions.desc: Mike Maloney opens his ten-part monetary history series with the most important distinction in personal finance: currency is what you spend, money is what holds value across time. Filmed partly in Egypt. The clearest mainstream education on what money actually is — free on YouTube, watched tens of millions of times.

transmissions.title: The Three Waves of Volunteers & The New Earth
transmissions.desc: Dolores Cannon's flagship lecture, delivered at the Ozark Mountain Transformation Conference. She lays out the thesis carried by her QHHT case histories: three successive waves of souls have come to Earth at this turning to lift the planet's frequency. The required-watching entry into the New-Earth thread on FRQNCY.

transmissions.title: Dolores Cannon on Volunteer Souls, Past Lives & Lost Knowledge
transmissions.desc: Long-form interview format. Cannon on Coast to Coast — the radio show that broke this material to a mainstream nighttime audience. Volunteer souls, past lives, and the lost knowledge she recovered across four decades of QHHT sessions. Pair with the Ozark presentation for breadth + depth on the same thesis.
